messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
I don’t have a price in mind. It should be based on a proper valuation, not a family discount that cuts into my share. I don’t know who the executor is or whether the house has been valued.

Thank you. I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, but I need C to agree. I don’t have a price in mind yet, and I don’t know who the executor is or whether the house has been valued.
Thank you. I’d like a cash share from the estate to help me start a dance studio. I’m not sure about an amount or timing yet.

I can check the will for the executor’s name. I’d be open to an independent valuation as a starting point, but I’d still hope for a family discount. I don’t have a specific amount in mind; the discount would make buying the house with my husband more feasible.
Yes, I’d consider A buying at the full appraised value, with the proceeds divided as the will requires. I don’t have a copy of the will.
I’d prefer a sale at full appraised value; a discount could mean less money for my studio. I’m not sure whether I have a copy of the will—A is checking it.
That might help, if the will and the legal arrangements allow it. I’d need to know the valuation and each of our shares before I could tell whether it’s affordable.
Yes, that plan works for me. I’ll check the will and share a copy with B and C.
Yes, that plan seems fair to me. I don’t have a firm date yet for the studio money.
It works as a starting point. I’m not agreeing to a discount; any purchase should be at full appraised value, with shares handled according to the will.
I’ll check the will for the executor’s name and send a copy to B and C.
Thank you. I’m glad we have a plan. I’ll wait for A to send the will and for the executor to confirm the shares before setting a date for the studio.
Fine. I’ll review the will when A sends it. To be clear, I’m not agreeing to a discount.
